p: right in the sight of the: As long as he listened to Zachariah the prophet.

smote the king: His father and grandfather were slain by their subjects and servants, and he because he would usurp the priest's office contrary to God's ordinance was smitten immediately by the hand of God with the leprosy, 2Ch 26:21.
judging the people of the land: As viceroy or deputy to his father.
months: He was the fourth in descent from Jehu, who reigned according to God's promise, but in him God began to execute his wrath against the house of Jehu.
slew him: Zachariah was the last in Israel, that had the kingdom by succession, save only Pekahiah the son of Menahem, who reigned only two years.
Tiphsah: Which was a city of Israel that would not receive him as their king.

talents of silver: Instead of seeking help from God, he went about by money to purchase the favour of this king being an infidel and therefore God forsook him, and Pul soon afterward broke his promises, destroyed his country and led his people away captive.
Argob and Arieh: Which were of the same conspiracy.
came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria: For God stirred up Pul and Tiglathpileser against Israel for their sins, 1Ch 5:26.
to all that his father Uzziah: He shows that his uprightness was not such, but that he had many great faults.
those days the LORD began to: After the death of Jotham.
Pekah the son of Remaliah: Who in one day slew 120,000 of Judah's fighting men 2Ch 28:6, because they had forsaken the true God.
